title: 1.1.1 Eligibility to Use the Site
content:
The AI should explain that the website and purchasing services are intended for adults who are legally able to enter into a binding agreement.

Default AI response:

“By using the Services, you confirm that you are at least 18 years old and legally able to enter into these Terms. If you are using the Services on behalf of an organization, you represent that you have authority to bind that organization to these Terms.”

Reference:

<https://ivyusa.com/policies/terms-of-service>

This language is already displayed on the website.

title: 1.1.2 Accurate Account and Order Information
content:
Customers must provide accurate and up-to-date information when creating an account or placing an order, including:

- Name

- Email address

- Phone number

- Shipping address

- Billing address

- Payment information

An account or order may be restricted, placed on hold, or canceled when false, unauthorized, or incorrect information is used.

Default AI response:

“Please make sure your account and order information is accurate and up to date. Incorrect information may cause shipping or payment issues and may require additional review.”

title: 1.2.1 Creating an Account
content: Customers may create an account on the IVY Beauty website. Complete and accurate information must be provided during registration.

title: 1.2.2 Account Security
content:
Customers are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of their password and login credentials.

Orders, rewards activity, reviews, and other actions completed through an account will generally be treated as activity authorized by the account holder.

Default AI response:

“Do not share your password or login information with anyone.”

title: 1.2.3 Unauthorized Access or Security Concerns
content:
If a customer suspects unauthorized access or an account security issue, the AI should direct the customer to contact Customer Support immediately.

Front-end button:

Contact Customer Support

title: 1.2.4 Updating Account Information
content:
Customers should keep their email address, phone number, and saved addresses up to date.

Updating an address in the customer account after an order has been placed may not update the shipping address on that existing order.

title: 1.2.5 Account Restrictions, Suspension, or Closure
content:
Default AI response:

“Following a review, IVY Beauty may restrict account access, suspend an account, or close an account for reasons such as:

- Providing false or inaccurate information

- Using another person’s identity or information without authorization

- Misusing promotions, coupons, discounts, or rewards

- Creating multiple accounts to receive duplicate benefits

- Excessive or abusive returns, refunds, or payment disputes

- Filing fraudulent or abusive chargebacks

- Unauthorized resale

- Interfering with or misusing the website or services

- Violating the Terms of Service or other applicable policies

The AI chatbot cannot make, reverse, or remove an account restriction, suspension, or closure. For details about your account status or to request a review, please contact Customer Support.”

The AI may not decide whether an account should be restricted or reinstate an account.

title: 1.3.1 Order Submission and Acceptance
content:
Submitting an order does not mean the order has been finally accepted.

An order may be declined, placed on hold, or canceled for reasons including:

- Item is out of stock

- Payment authorization failed

- Pricing or product information error

- Suspected fraud or unauthorized activity

- Policy violation

- Unsupported shipping destination

- Other order-processing limitations

Default AI response:

“After your order is submitted, payment and inventory are reviewed. Your order is considered accepted once it has been confirmed and moves into processing or fulfillment.”

title: 1.3.2 Pricing and Product Information Errors
content:
IVY Beauty makes reasonable efforts to keep prices and product information accurate.

If a system error, typographical error, or incorrect product listing is identified, IVY Beauty may contact the customer and correct or cancel the order.

The AI must not promise that an incorrectly displayed price will be honored.

title: 1.3.3 Payment Authorization
content:
Customers must provide valid and accurate payment information.

If a payment method is declined or cannot be authorized, the order may not be successfully created or processed.

title: 1.3.4 Inventory Availability and Order Cancellation
content:
All orders are subject to product availability.

If an item becomes unavailable, IVY Beauty may:

- Remove the unavailable item from the order

- Cancel the entire order

- Contact the customer with additional information

- Issue a refund for the unavailable item or canceled order

The final resolution depends on the order status and must be confirmed by Customer Support.

title: 1.3.5 Incorrect Order Information
content:
Delivery issues caused by an incorrect shipping address, phone number, or other order information may require customer verification.

If an order is returned because of an address error, additional shipping charges may apply.

Default AI response:

“If a shipping issue was caused by an incorrect address, phone number, or order detail, Customer Support will need to review the order. Additional shipping charges may apply if the package is returned or needs to be reshipped.”

title: 1.4 Prohibited Activity and Policy Abuse
content:
The following activity is not permitted:

- Creating accounts with false information

- Using multiple accounts to redeem duplicate coupons or offers

- Manipulating loyalty points or rewards

- Placing fraudulent orders

- Using stolen or unauthorized payment information

- Intentionally exploiting a pricing error

- Repeatedly placing and canceling orders in an abusive manner

- Excessive or abusive returns, refunds, or payment disputes

- Filing bad-faith chargebacks for orders that were properly fulfilled

The AI must not directly accuse a customer of fraud or abuse.

Default AI response:

“If activity of this type is identified, the account or order may be subject to additional review, restrictions, or suspension. Please contact Customer Support for details.”

title: 1.5 User-Generated Content
content:
This policy applies to content submitted by customers, including:

- Product reviews

- Photos

- Videos

- Comments

- Survey responses

- Beautizen content

- RoundTable content

- Social media posts

Customers may submit only content they own or have permission to use.

Content may be rejected, limited, or removed if it includes:

- Copyright or intellectual property infringement

- Fake or misleading reviews

- Abusive, hateful, discriminatory, or harassing content

- Illegal content

- Personal or confidential information

- Advertising, solicitation, or spam

- Large volumes of fabricated AI-generated reviews

Specific content usage rights should be addressed separately in the Beautizen and other program terms.

title: 1.6.1 Information IVY Beauty May Collect or Process
content:
IVY Beauty may collect or process information needed to provide its services, including:

- Order information

- Payment information

- Shipping information

- Customer account information

- Email address and phone number

- Membership tier information

- Loyalty point earning and redemption history

- Beautizen activity

- RoundTable survey and product-testing information

- B2B, wholesale, and application information

- Customer Support communications

- AI chatbot conversations

- Website usage information

- Marketing preferences and consent status

The AI may provide only general information about data collection and use. Detailed privacy questions should be directed to the applicable Privacy Policy or Customer Support.

title: 1.6.2 Customer Support and AI Chat Data
content:
Information entered into the AI chatbot may be used to respond to inquiries, improve services, and connect the customer with Customer Support.

Customers should not enter the following information in the chat:

- Full credit or debit card number

- Card security code

- Password

- Social Security number

- Government-issued identification number

- Full medical records

- Other highly sensitive personal information

title: 1.6.3 Marketing Opt-Out
content:
Customers may opt out of email or text marketing.

Members may update their email newsletter preferences through:

MY IVY > MY PROFILE

Default AI response:

“You can review and update your email preferences on this page.”

Front-end button:

Manage Email Preferences

title: 1.6.4 U.S. State Privacy Rights
content:
Depending on the customer’s state of residence, the customer may have rights to request:

- Access to personal information

- Correction of personal information

- Deletion of personal information

- Restriction of certain processing

- Opt-out of certain sharing or targeted advertising

Requirements vary by state, including California and other states. The AI may explain how to submit a request, but Customer Support or the appropriate privacy team must process the request.

title: 1.6.5 Suspected Data Breach or Security Incident
content:
If a customer suspects that personal information has been exposed or an account has been compromised, the AI should direct the customer to Customer Support immediately.

The AI may not determine whether a breach occurred or promise compensation.

title: 1.7.1 Email Newsletter Sign-Up
content:
Customers may subscribe to email updates through the website footer.

Members may also manage email preferences through:

MY IVY > MY PROFILE

title: 1.7.2 Email Marketing Consent
content:
Customers who provide an email address and consent to marketing may receive:

- Promotions

- New product announcements

- Member offers

- Events

- Brand news

title: 1.7.3 SMS Marketing
content:
If SMS marketing is offered, separate consent must be collected.

Email consent and SMS consent must be managed separately.

title: 1.7.4 Unsubscribing
content:
Customers may unsubscribe through the Unsubscribe link in an email or through account settings.

It may take a reasonable amount of time for an opt-out request to be reflected in all systems.

Default AI response:

“You can review or update your marketing preferences on this page.”

title: 2.1.1 Order Processing Time
content:
Orders are processed Monday through Friday.

Orders may not be processed on:

- Weekends

- U.S. federal holidays

- Company-observed holidays

Order processing generally takes 1–3 business days.

Orders placed before 11:00 a.m. Eastern Time may begin processing the same day, but same-day shipment is not guaranteed.

Default AI response:

“Orders generally take 1–3 business days to process. Weekends and holidays are not included in processing time.”

title: 2.1.2 Estimated Delivery Time
content:
After shipment, most orders are delivered within 5–7 business days.

Order processing time and carrier transit time are separate.

Example:

- Processing: 1–3 business days

- Estimated transit time after shipment: 5–7 business days

The AI must not guarantee delivery by a specific date.

title: 2.1.3 Shipping Rates and Free Shipping Thresholds
content:
Standard U.S. shipping:

- Guest checkout: Free standard shipping on qualifying orders of $29.99 or more

- IVY Beauty members: Free standard shipping on qualifying orders of $19.99 or more

- Orders below the applicable threshold: $4.99 standard shipping

The free-shipping threshold is based on the final merchandise subtotal after applying:

- Discounts

- Promotions

- Coupons

- Rewards

A lower free-shipping threshold may apply to certain membership tiers.

title: 2.1.4 Shipping Destinations
content:
IVY Beauty currently ships to:

- The 48 contiguous United States

IVY Beauty does not currently ship to:

- International destinations

- Alaska

- Hawaii

- Puerto Rico

- U.S. Virgin Islands

- Other U.S. territories

- APO addresses

- FPO addresses

- DPO addresses

International shipping is not currently available.

Default AI response:

“IVY Beauty currently ships only within the 48 contiguous United States. International shipping is not available.”

title: 2.1.5 Order Tracking
content:
A shipping confirmation email is sent after the order ships.

The email includes a tracking number.

Customers may track the shipment through the carrier’s website.

Tracking information may take up to 48 hours to appear or update in the carrier’s system.

Front-end button:

Track My Order

title: 2.1.6 Shipping Address
content:
Customers must review the shipping address before submitting the order.

The shipping address generally cannot be changed after an order has been submitted.

If an order is returned because of an incorrect or incomplete address:

- Original shipping charges are non-refundable

- A reshipping fee may apply

- Return-related charges may be deducted from any refund

The AI may not update a shipping address and must direct address-change requests to Customer Support.

title: 2.1.7 Order Changes and Cancellations
content:
After an order has been submitted, product, quantity, address, and other order details generally cannot be changed.

Customers should contact Customer Support as soon as possible to request a cancellation.

Cancellation availability depends on the order’s fulfillment status.

Default AI response:

“Orders may begin processing immediately after submission, so changes and cancellations cannot be guaranteed. Please contact hello@ivyusa.com as soon as possible.”

title: 2.1.8 Undeliverable and Return-to-Sender Packages
content:
A package may be returned to sender because of:

- Incomplete address

- Incorrect address

- Refused delivery

- Package not picked up within the carrier’s hold period

- Carrier determination that the package is undeliverable

A returned package may be handled by:

- Reshipping after the customer pays an additional shipping fee

- Refunding the order after applicable charges are deducted

Until the deduction policy is finalized, the AI must not quote a guaranteed refund amount.

title: 2.1.9 Marked Delivered but Not Received
content:
If tracking shows “Delivered” but the customer cannot locate the package, the AI should first recommend:

- Allowing up to 48 hours after the delivery scan

- Confirming the shipping address

- Checking the front door, side door, porch, garage, or other delivery location

- Checking the mailroom or package room

- Checking with building staff or property management

- Checking with household members or neighbors

- Contacting the carrier to open a claim

- For USPS shipments, using the USPS Missing Mail search process

IVY Beauty does not automatically guarantee a refund or replacement for packages lost, stolen, or misdelivered after the carrier marks them as delivered.

IVY Beauty may provide supporting information for a carrier claim, including:

- Order details

- Tracking number

- Shipping records

The AI must not promise a refund or replacement and should direct the customer to Customer Support.

title: 2.1.10 Freight Forwarders and Third-Party Reshipping Services
content:
When a customer uses a freight forwarder, parcel forwarder, or reshipping service, IVY Beauty’s delivery responsibility may end when the package is delivered to that forwarding address.

Issues occurring after delivery to the forwarding service may not be eligible for reimbursement, including:

- Loss

- Damage

- Theft

- Customs issues

- Reshipping issues

- Delivery delays

After delivery to the forwarding service, the customer and forwarding provider are responsible for onward shipping, customs, and related documentation.

title: 2.2.1 Return Eligibility
content:
A return request may be submitted only when all of the following conditions are met:

- The item was purchased directly from ivyusa.com

- The item is unopened

- The item is unused

- The shade, color, or formula has not been tested

- The item is in its original packaging

- All seals and protective packaging are intact

- The return is requested within 10 days of confirmed delivery

Default AI response:

“Unopened and unused items purchased from ivyusa.com may be eligible for return when the request is submitted within 10 days of delivery.”

title: 2.2.2 Return Shipping Fee
content:
A $6.95 return shipping fee applies.

The $6.95 fee is deducted from the final refund amount.

Original outbound shipping charges are non-refundable.

title: 2.2.3 How to Request a Return
content:
Return request steps:

1\.  Go to account.ivyusa.com

2\.  Sign in to the customer account

3\.  Select the applicable order

4\.  Select “Request return”

5\.  Select the item or items to return

6\.  Select a return reason

7\.  Add details if needed

8\.  Submit the return request

9\.  Wait for approval

10\.  After approval, receive the prepaid return label by email

11\.  Ship the approved return within 5 days

Front-end button:

Request a Return

title: 2.2.4 Return Shipment Deadline
content:
Once a return is approved, the item must be shipped within 5 days of the approval date.

If the package is not shipped within 5 days:

- The return request may expire or be canceled

- The request may not be reopened or approved again

- An item sent without a valid approval may not qualify for a refund

title: 2.2.5 Return Label and Return Address
content:
After approval, IVY Beauty provides a prepaid return label by email.

A return may not qualify for a refund if it is:

- Sent directly to a corporate or office address

- Sent to an unauthorized address

- Sent without prior approval

- Sent without trackable shipping

title: 2.2.6 Return Inspection
content:
All returned items are inspected after arrival.

Items that do not meet the return requirements will not be refunded.

Items that fail inspection may not be sent back to the customer.

A refund cannot be issued if carrier tracking does not show that the return was delivered to IVY Beauty.

The AI must not guarantee the inspection result.

title: 2.2.7 Refund Processing
content:
A refund is issued after the returned item arrives and passes inspection.

Refunds are issued to the original payment method.

IVY Beauty generally issues the refund within 10 business days after confirmed delivery of the return.

The time required for the refund to appear on the customer’s account depends on the bank, card issuer, or payment provider.

title: 2.2.8 Non-Returnable and Non-Refundable Items
content:
The following are generally not eligible for return or refund:

- Clearance items

- Final Sale items

- Free gifts

- Promotional gifts

- International orders

- Bulk orders

- Wholesale orders

- Opened items

- Used items

- Items on which the shade, color, or formula has been tested

The AI may not approve exceptions and should direct exception requests to Customer Support.

title: 2.2.9 Refund Amount for Discounted or Promotional Orders
content:
Refunds are based on the amount actually paid after discounts and promotions.

If a return causes the order to fall below a promotion requirement:

- Promotional discounts may be recalculated

- Free-shipping eligibility may be recalculated

- Gift-with-purchase eligibility may be removed

If the customer no longer qualifies for a free gift, the gift may also need to be returned unused.

If the gift is not returned, its regular retail value may be deducted from the refund.

title: 2.2.10 Shade, Color, and Formula Selection
content:
Customers who are unsure about a shade, color, or formula should consider testing the product at an authorized retail location before purchasing.

Product selection and inventory vary by retailer, so customers should contact the store before visiting.

Items that have been tested are not eligible under the standard return policy.

title: 2.2.11 Exchanges
content:
IVY Beauty does not offer direct exchanges.

Customers who want a different item should:

1\.  Return the original item, if eligible

2\.  Place a separate order for the new item

Default AI response:

“IVY Beauty does not offer direct exchanges. Please return the original item, if eligible, and place a new order for the item you want.”

title: 2.2.12 Items Purchased from Other Retailers
content:
Items purchased from a third-party retailer are not eligible for return through ivyusa.com.

Customers must follow the return policy of the original seller.

Examples:

- Amazon

- Walmart

- Brick-and-mortar stores

- Other online or physical retailers

The AI should first confirm the purchase location and then direct the customer to the appropriate retailer.

title: 2.3.1 Requesting an Order Cancellation
content:
Customers should email hello@ivyusa.com as soon as possible to request cancellation.

The AI should ask the customer to provide:

- Order number

- Email address used for the order

- Reason for the cancellation request

title: 2.3.2 Modifying an Order
content:
The following generally cannot be changed after order submission:

- Product

- Shade or color

- Quantity

- Shipping address

- Payment method

- Coupon

- Rewards redemption

The customer may need to request cancellation and place a new order.

title: 2.3.3 Whether a Cancellation Is Possible
content:
An order may be canceled only if fulfillment has not progressed too far.

Orders may automatically move into:

- Picking

- Packing

- Shipping label creation

- Shipment preparation

IVY Beauty will make reasonable efforts to honor a cancellation request, but cancellation is not guaranteed.

An order cannot be canceled after shipment.

After shipment, the customer must use the return process if the item is eligible.

title: 2.3.4 Items Requiring Final Policy Approval
content:
The following must be finalized before the AI provides definitive answers:

- Cancellation request cutoff

- Whether a cancellation confirmation email is sent

- Whether a coupon is restored after cancellation

- When redeemed rewards are restored

- How long a reversed card authorization takes to appear

Until confirmed, the AI must not guarantee a specific timeframe.

title: 2.4.1 Automatic Refunds
content:
A package returned to sender by the carrier is not automatically refunded.

The customer must contact Customer Support within 10 days of the first delivery attempt.

title: 2.4.2 Review Process
content:
IVY Beauty may review:

- Order status

- Tracking status

- Return-to-sender reason

- Whether the returned package has been received

A refund may be processed only after the package is physically received and reviewed.

title: 2.4.3 Refund Amount
content:
Under the current draft policy, the standard $6.95 return fee may be deducted.

Original shipping charges are non-refundable.

The following deduction methods still require internal approval:

- Deduct only $6.95

- Deduct $6.95 plus the original shipping charge

- Deduct $6.95 plus a separate restocking fee

- Apply different deductions based on the return-to-sender reason

Until finalized, the AI must not guarantee the final refund amount.

title: 2.5.1 Reporting Deadline
content:
Customers should report a missing, damaged, or incorrect item to hello@ivyusa.com within 48 hours of delivery.

Claims submitted more than 7 days after delivery may not be eligible for a refund or replacement.

title: 2.5.2 Information and Documentation Required
content:
Customers may be asked to provide:

- Order number

- Photo of the shipping box

- Photo of the shipping label

- Photo of the packing slip

- Photo of all items received

- Photo showing the missing, damaged, or incorrect item issue

- Product barcode

- Batch number or lot number

- Brief description of the issue

title: 2.5.3 Possible Resolutions
content:
After review, IVY Beauty may:

- Send a replacement

- Issue a refund

- Issue store credit

- Request additional documentation

- Direct the customer to file a carrier claim

The AI may not choose or promise a resolution.

title: 2.5.4 Items Requiring Final Policy Approval
content:
The following still require internal approval:

- Whether the 48-hour period is mandatory or recommended

- How claims submitted after 48 hours but within 7 days are handled

- Whether exceptions are allowed after 7 days

- Whether incorrect items must be returned

- Criteria for replacement, refund, or store credit

title: 2.6.1 Accepted Payment Methods
content:
Current payment methods:

- Credit cards

- Debit cards

- Apple Pay

- Google Pay

- PayPal

- IVY Beauty Reward Points

title: 2.6.2 Card Authorization and Payment Capture
content:
A payment authorization may be requested when an order is submitted.

Some transactions may appear as a pending authorization.

The final posting date and payment status depend on the bank, card issuer, or payment provider.

title: 2.6.3 Charged but No Order Was Created
content:
This is a high-risk inquiry that the AI cannot verify.

The AI should ask the customer to check:

- Whether an order confirmation email was received

- Order history in the customer account

- The payment provider’s authorization status

- Whether duplicate orders were created

The AI should then direct the customer to Customer Support.

title: 2.6.4 Payment Declined
content:
If payment is declined, the AI may recommend checking:

- Card information

- Billing address

- Expiration date

- Available balance or credit limit

- Online purchase restrictions set by the card issuer

- Whether another payment method is available

The AI cannot view the specific reason for a card decline.

title: 2.6.5 Duplicate Charge
content:
If a duplicate charge is suspected, the AI must not promise a refund.

The customer should prepare the order number, transaction date, and transaction amount and contact Customer Support.

title: 2.6.6 Suspected Fraud or Unauthorized Payment
content:
An order may be placed on hold or canceled if fraud, account takeover, or unauthorized payment activity is suspected.

The AI must not disclose internal fraud-screening rules.

title: 2.6.7 Sales Tax
content:
Sales tax may be calculated at checkout based on the shipping address and applicable law.

The AI may not determine whether an individual customer qualifies for a tax exemption.

title: 2.6.8 Refund Method
content:
Refunds are issued to the original payment method.

A refund cannot be sent to a different card, paid in cash, or transferred to an unrelated account.

title: 2.6.9 Chargebacks and Payment Disputes
content:
The AI may not manage a chargeback or payment dispute.

A bad-faith or abusive chargeback related to a properly fulfilled order may be reviewed as a policy violation.

title: 2.7.1 New Customer Coupon
content:
A new customer coupon may be selected or entered at checkout.

If the coupon does not appear or apply, the AI should recommend checking:

- Whether the customer is signed in

- New-customer eligibility

- Expiration date

- Excluded products

- Minimum purchase requirement

- Whether another promotion is already applied

title: 2.7.2 Coupon Stacking
content:
Some promotional codes may be combined.

If stacking is not allowed, checkout will display an applicable message.

The AI must not say that all coupons can be combined.

title: 2.7.3 Promotional Exclusions
content:
Certain products or orders may be excluded from promotions.

Examples:

- Final Sale

- Clearance

- Selected brands or products

- B2B orders

- Beauty Professional orders

- Bulk orders

- Free gifts

- Already-discounted items

title: 2.7.4 Gifts with Purchase
content:
Gift-with-purchase offers require the order to meet the stated qualifying conditions.

If a return causes the order to no longer qualify, the promotional gift may also need to be returned.

title: 3.1 Membership Program
content:
Current or planned member benefits may include:

- Member-only sales

- Early access to new products

- Gifts for higher membership tiers

- Points on eligible purchases

- Tier-based earning rates

- Lower free-shipping thresholds than guest checkout

Early-access functionality should be added to the AI only after its actual availability is confirmed.

title: 3.2 Membership Tiers
content:
Current tiers:

- IVY

- Red

- Gold

- Ruby

Current earning rates:

- IVY: 1 point per $1

- Red: 2 points per $1

- Gold: 3 points per $1

- Ruby: 4 points per $1

Default AI response:

“Members earn 1–4 points per $1, depending on their membership tier.”

title: 3.2.1 Tier Upgrades
content:
Tiers are intended to be based on the customer’s qualifying purchase total.

The following still require approval:

- Measurement period

- Spend thresholds

- Tier validity period

- How cancellations and returns affect qualifying spend

- Free-shipping threshold for each tier

title: 3.2.2 Tier Downgrades
content:
There is currently no separate tier-downgrade policy.

Default AI response:

“There is currently no automatic tier downgrade. This policy may be updated in the future.”

title: 3.3.1 Earning Points
content:
Eligible member orders automatically earn points based on the customer’s tier.

The following still require approval:

- Eligible merchandise subtotal

- Whether shipping and tax earn points

- When points become available

title: 3.3.2 Redeeming Points
content:
Customers may redeem up to $10 in rewards per order.

The current points balance is available in MY IVY.

Front-end button:

Go to MY IVY

title: 3.3.3 Cancellations and Returns
content:
Points earned from a canceled or returned order may be reversed.

The timing for restoring points used on a canceled order still requires internal confirmation.

title: 3.3.4 Point Restrictions
content:
General rules:

- Points cannot be redeemed for cash

- Points cannot be transferred to another person

- Points cannot be moved between accounts

- Duplicate point awards may be reversed

- Points earned through fraudulent or abusive activity may be canceled

title: 3.3.5 Point Expiration
content:
The expiration period and forfeiture rules still require approval.

Until finalized, the AI must not provide an expiration date.

title: 3.3.6 Program Rewards vs. Purchase Rewards
content:
Standard purchase points may be tracked separately from:

- Beautizen review rewards

- RoundTable participation rewards

- Promotional rewards

- Manually issued points

title: 3.4 Multiple Account Policy
content:
As a general rule, one customer may maintain one account.

If multiple accounts are created, IVY Beauty may:

- Remove promotional eligibility

- Cancel coupons

- Reverse points

- Merge accounts

- Restrict or suspend accounts

If a separate account is required for a specific company-operated program, IVY Beauty may create or approve an exception.

The AI must not encourage customers to create additional accounts.

title: 4.1 Program Overview
content:
IVY Beauty may offer special pricing or discounts to beauty-industry professionals and students enrolled in eligible programs.

Applicants must have an IVY Beauty account.

Application page:

<https://ivyusa.com/pages/beauty-pro-students>

Front-end button:

Apply for Beauty Pro

title: 4.2 Eligibility
content:
Potentially eligible applicants include:

- Beauty-industry professionals

- Licensed professionals

- Students enrolled in an eligible beauty-related program

- Other applicants approved by IVY Beauty

Final eligibility is determined after document review.

title: 4.3 Verification Documents
content:
Applicants may be asked to submit proof of professional or student status, such as:

- Cosmetology or professional license

- Business documentation

- Student ID

- Proof of enrollment

- School registration documentation

The AI may not determine whether an application will be approved.

title: 4.4 Discount Benefit
content:
Beauty Pro members may receive 20% off eligible orders by using their dedicated discount code.

Default AI response:

“Beauty Pro members can receive 20% off eligible orders by applying their dedicated discount code at checkout.”

Whether the discount can be combined with promotions, rewards, or other codes depends on checkout rules and the applicable program terms.

title: 5.1 Current Default Response
content:
If the Beautizen program is not yet open, the AI must not provide unconfirmed participation or reward details.

Default AI response:

“The Beautizen program is currently being prepared. Please check back after the program officially launches.”

When needed, direct inquiries to:

beautizen@ivyusa.com

title: 5.2 Planned Program Activities
content:
The Beautizen program may include:

- Product sampling

- Product reviews

- Social media sharing

- Features on the brand website

- Reward opportunities

- Ambassador networking

Until the program officially launches, the AI must not guarantee participation or compensation.

title: 5.3 Review Rewards
content:
Current operational concept under review:

- Review points are generally issued on the Friday following review submission

- Inquiries: beautizen@ivyusa.com

The following still require approval:

- Eligible reviews

- Review moderation criteria

- Reward issuance date

- Ineligible reviews

- Duplicate reviews

- Deleted reviews

- Fake or misleading reviews

- Duplicate rewards

- AI-generated reviews

- Treatment of negative reviews

The AI must not state that submitting a review guarantees points.

title: 5.4 Negative Reviews
content:
A review should not be excluded from rewards solely because it is negative.

However, a review may be ineligible if it includes:

- False or misleading claims

- A review from someone who did not use the product

- Duplicate submissions

- Spam

- Copied content

- Fabricated AI-generated content

- Other policy-violating content

title: 5.5 Sponsored Content Disclosure
content:
Customers who receive free products, points, or other incentives may be required to clearly disclose the brand relationship under applicable FTC endorsement guidelines.

The AI should not provide individualized legal advice and should direct participants to the official program guidelines.

title: 5.6 Use of Participant Content
content:
Subject to the final program terms and any required consent, IVY Beauty may repost or use participant-submitted photos, videos, reviews, and social media handles as brand content.

The following require separate policy approval or consent language:

- Content ownership

- Reposting on official brand accounts

- Use of photos, videos, or social media handles

- Website publication

- Email marketing use

- Paid advertising use

- Editing rights

- Content removal requests

- Copyright

- Right of publicity and likeness rights

title: 6.1 Program Activities
content:
The RoundTable program may include:

- Surveys

- Product testing

- Focus groups

- New product feedback

- Participation rewards

The AI should provide an application link only when a program is actively recruiting.

title: 6.2.1 Application and Selection
content:
Submitting an application does not guarantee selection.

Selection criteria may include:

- Age

- Skin type or skin concerns

- Hair type or hair concerns

- Allergies

- Sensitivities

- Pregnancy or breastfeeding status

- Prior product experience

- Other study-specific criteria

The AI must not guarantee selection.

title: 6.2.2 Product Use
content:
Selected participants must follow the provided instructions and testing period.

Test products may not be transferred, gifted, or resold.

title: 6.2.3 Survey and Content Submission
content:
Participants may be required to submit:

- Testing survey

- Product feedback

- Photos

- Videos

- Product-use log

title: 6.2.4 Incomplete Participation
content:
Participants who do not complete the product test or required survey may:

- Become ineligible for rewards

- Be restricted from future program participation

title: 6.2.5 Adverse Reactions
content:
If an adverse reaction occurs during product testing, the participant should stop using the product immediately.

For severe, persistent, or worsening symptoms, the participant should contact a qualified healthcare professional.

The AI may not provide medical diagnosis or treatment advice and should direct the customer to Customer Support or the program team.

title: 6.3 Focus Groups
content:
The focus-group policy should address:

- Participant selection

- Attendance date and time

- Rescheduling

- Audio and video recording

- Confidentiality

- Personal information handling

- Compensation

- Event cancellation

- No-show policy

The AI may not approve attendance, compensation, or exceptions.

title: 7.1 Current Default Response
content:
If B2B and wholesale terms have not been finalized, use:

“B2B and wholesale pricing, order requirements, and account terms require review by the appropriate team. Please contact Customer Support for assistance.”

The AI must not disclose unapproved pricing or contract terms.

title: 7.2 Wholesale Account Application
content:
Applicants may be asked to provide:

- Business information

- EIN

- Resale certificate

- Sales tax exemption documentation

- Sales channels

- Website or store information

- Estimated order volume

- Primary contact information

IVY Beauty may approve or decline an application.

Approved accounts may be reviewed periodically.

title: 7.3 B2B Pricing and Ordering
content:
The following require final approval:

- Wholesale pricing

- Minimum order quantity

- Minimum order value

- Case-pack requirements

- Quote validity period

- Order changes

- Order cancellations

- Out-of-stock handling

- Partial shipments

- Prepayment requirements

- Credit terms

- Consumer coupon restrictions

- Rewards restrictions

The AI must not provide pricing or discounts that have not been approved.

title: 7.4 B2B Shipping
content:
The B2B shipping policy should address:

- Bulk-order processing time

- Small-parcel shipping

- Freight shipping

- Pallet shipments

- Shipping charges

- Free-shipping eligibility

- Split shipments

- Inspection at delivery

- Shortage claims

- Damage claims

- Transfer of risk

title: 7.5 B2B Returns
content:
The current B2C return policy excludes:

- Bulk orders

- Wholesale orders

- International orders

A separate B2B return policy is required.

The future policy should address:

- Prior return authorization

- Return window

- Unopened case requirements

- Return shipping

- Restocking fee

- Special-order items

- Discontinued items

- Discounted items

- Defective items

- Missing items

- Damaged items

- Substitutions

- Account credit

The AI may not approve a B2B return.

title: 7.6 Authorized Sales Channels
content:
Sales channels used by B2B customers may require prior approval.

Channels subject to review may include:

- Amazon

- Walmart Marketplace

- eBay

- TikTok Shop

- Brick-and-mortar retail stores

- The customer’s own website

- Dropshipping

- International resale

Restricted activity may include:

- Unauthorized distribution

- Selling on unapproved marketplaces

- Reselling testers

- Reselling free samples

- Unauthorized use of brand images

- Unapproved advertising or product claims

title: 8.1 Product Use and Patch Testing
content:
The AI should remind customers to:

- Read the product label

- Follow the directions for use

- Consider a patch test before use

- Review ingredients for known allergens

- Consider individual skin or scalp sensitivity

- Stop use if irritation occurs

- Avoid contact with eyes or mucous membranes

- Keep products out of reach of children

The AI must not state that a product is safe for every customer.

title: 8.2 Adverse Reactions
content:
Customers should stop using the product if they experience:

- Rash

- Itching

- Swelling

- Eye irritation

- Pain

- Severe redness

- Difficulty breathing

For difficulty breathing, severe swelling, or another medical emergency, the customer should seek immediate medical care.

The AI may not diagnose a condition, recommend treatment, or advise on medication.

title: 8.3 Information for an Adverse Event Report
content:
Customers may be asked to provide:

- Product name

- Shade, color, or type

- Batch number or lot number

- Order number

- Date of product use

- Date symptoms began

- How the product was used

- Other products used at the same time

- Photos of the symptoms

- Photos of the product

- Whether medical care was sought

Sensitive medical information should be requested only when necessary and only to the minimum extent required.

title: 8.4 Internal Escalation
content:
Serious adverse events should be escalated to the quality or regulatory team.

Follow-up may include:

- Product retrieval

- Additional interview

- Batch or lot verification

- Quality testing

- Record retention

- Regulatory review

The AI must not state that an adverse event case has been closed or resolved.

title: 8.5 Product Quality Complaints
content:
The following may be reported as product quality issues:

- Leakage

- Defective container

- Defective pump

- Defective sprayer

- Change in odor

- Change in color

- Foreign material

- Suspected contamination

- Packaging defect

Customers may be asked to provide:

- Order number

- Product name

- Batch number or lot number

- Photos or video of the issue

- Photos of the packaging

Depending on the review, IVY Beauty may issue a refund or replacement, but the AI may not approve or promise either outcome.

title: 9.1 Activity Subject to Review
content:
IVY Beauty may review activity involving:

- Promotion abuse

- Rewards abuse

- False or inaccurate information

- Intentional exploitation of pricing errors

- Multiple-account use

- Repeated abuse of free-shipping offers

- Excessive or abusive returns

- Repeated payment disputes

- Fraudulent or bad-faith chargebacks

- Unauthorized resale

- Unusual or suspicious bulk ordering

title: 9.2 Order and Account Review
content:
If suspicious or abusive activity is identified, IVY Beauty may:

- Place an order on hold

- Consolidate orders

- Cancel an order

- Request additional identity verification

- Verify payment information

- Reverse points

- Cancel coupons

- Restrict account access

- Suspend an account

- Limit future purchases

If multiple orders are consolidated, shipping charges paid on each order may remain non-refundable.

title: 9.3 AI Response Standard
content:
The AI must not disclose internal review criteria, fraud-screening methods, or detection rules.

The AI must not label a customer as fraudulent or abusive.

Default AI response:

“Some orders may require additional review based on account, payment, or promotional activity. Please contact Customer Support for more information.”

title: 9.4 Requesting a Review
content:
A customer who disagrees with an account or order restriction may request a review through Customer Support.

Removing a restriction or approving an exception requires authorized staff review.
